FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8 AS build
WORKDIR /app
RUN corepack enable
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
COPY . .
RUN VITE_API_URL=/api pnpm run build
WORKDIR /app/server
RUN npm ci
RUN ./node_modules/.bin/prisma generate
# Extract only the original categories and system settings, never demo accounts.
RUN node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const s=fs.readFileSync("prisma/seed.ts","utf8");const prefix=s.slice(0,s.indexOf("  const adminHash"));if(!prefix.includes("async function main()"))throw Error("Unexpected seed");fs.writeFileSync("initialize.ts",prefix+"}\nexport async function initializeDefaults() { if (!(await prisma.systemSetting.findUnique({where:{id:1}}))) await main(); }\n");'
RUN printf '%s\n' 'import express from "express";' 'import cors from "cors";' 'import fs from "node:fs/promises";' 'import path from "node:path";' 'import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";' 'import { prisma } from "./src/prisma.ts";' 'import { initializeDefaults } from "./initialize.ts";' 'for (const name of ["JWT_SECRET", "APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD"]) if (!process.env[name]) throw Error("Missing runtime variable: " + name);' 'process.env.DATABASE_URL = "file:/app/.data/application.sqlite";' 'await fs.mkdir("/app/.data/uploads", {recursive:true});' 'await initializeDefaults();' 'const owner = await prisma.admin.findUnique({where:{username:"sindiswa-cell"}});' 'if (!owner) {' '  if (await prisma.admin.count()) throw Error("Existing instance requires reviewed owner provisioning");' '  await prisma.admin.create({data:{username:"sindiswa-cell",fullName:"System Administrator",email:"sindiswa-cell@localhost.invalid",passwordHash:await bcrypt.hash(process.env.APP_ADMIN_PASSWORD,12),active:true,mustChangePassword:false}});' '}' 'const app = express();' 'app.disable("x-powered-by");' 'app.set("trust proxy", false);' 'app.use(cors({origin:process.env.CLIENT_ORIGIN || false,credentials:true}));' 'app.use(express.json({limit:"2mb"}));' 'function sameOrigin(value) {' '  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(sameOrigin);' '  if (value && typeof value === "object" && !(value instanceof Date)) {' '    return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(value).map(([k,v]) => {' '      if (k === "previewUrl" && typeof v === "string") { const u = new URL(v,"http://localhost"); if(u.pathname.startsWith("/uploads/")) return [k,u.pathname+u.search]; }' '      return [k,sameOrigin(v)];' '    }));' '  }' '  return value;' '}' 'app.use((req,res,next)=>{res.setHeader("X-Content-Type-Options","nosniff");const json=res.json.bind(res);res.json=(body)=>json(sameOrigin(body));next();});' 'app.use("/uploads",async(req,res,next)=>{' '  res.setHeader("Content-Security-Policy","sandbox; default-src \u0027none\u0027; base-uri \u0027none\u0027; form-action \u0027none\u0027");' '  res.setHeader("X-Content-Type-Options","nosniff");' '  res.setHeader("Cache-Control","private, no-store");' '  try {' '    const name=decodeURIComponent(req.path.slice(1));' '    if (!name || name !== path.basename(name) || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$/.test(name) || name.startsWith(".")) return res.sendStatus(404);' '    const handle=await fs.open(path.join("/app/.data/uploads",name),"r");' '    let valid=false;' '    try {const bytes=Buffer.alloc(8);await handle.read(bytes,0,8,0);valid=/^%PDF-[12]\.[0-9]/.test(bytes.toString("ascii"));} finally {await handle.close();}' '    if (!valid) return res.status(415).type("text/plain").send("Not a PDF document");' '    res.setHeader("Content-Type","application/pdf");' '    res.setHeader("Content-Disposition","inline; filename=document.pdf");' '    next();' '  } catch {res.sendStatus(404);}' '},express.static("/app/.data/uploads",{index:false,redirect:false,fallthrough:false,setHeaders(res){res.setHeader("Content-Type","application/pdf");}}));' 'app.get("/api/health",(_req,res)=>res.json({ok:true,service:"ihoped-api"}));' 'for (const name of ["auth","applications","documents","clients","notifications","admin"]) {' '  const {default:router}=await import("./src/routes/"+name+".ts");' '  app.use("/api/"+name,router);' '}' 'app.use("/api",(_req,res)=>res.status(404).json({error:"Not found"}));' 'app.use(express.static("/app/dist",{index:false,redirect:false}));' 'app.get("/{*path}",(_req,res)=>res.sendFile("/app/dist/index.html"));' 'app.use((err,req,res,next)=>{console.error(err);if(res.headersSent)return next(err);res.status(err.status || 500).json({error:err.message || "Server error"});});' 'const server=app.listen(4000,"0.0.0.0");' 'for(const signal of ["SIGTERM","SIGINT"])process.on(signal,()=>server.close(async()=>{await prisma.$disconnect();process.exit(0);}));' > deploy.mjs
FROM docker.io/library/node@sha256:a34ab6d7f6f4813f4d0c5469d74685604b962fbdbf5793a7bc7b4998ecb867c8 AS runtime
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production PORT=4000 DATABASE_URL=file:/app/.data/application.sqlite HOME=/tmp TSX_DISABLE_CACHE=1
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build /app/server/node_modules ./server/node_modules
COPY --from=build /app/server/package.json ./server/package.json
COPY --from=build /app/server/src ./server/src
COPY --from=build /app/server/prisma/schema.prisma ./server/prisma/schema.prisma
COPY --from=build /app/server/initialize.ts ./server/initialize.ts
COPY --from=build /app/server/deploy.mjs ./server/deploy.mjs
RUN mkdir -p /app/.data && ln -s /app/.data/uploads /app/server/uploads && chown 10001:10001 /app/.data
USER 10001:10001
EXPOSE 4000
CMD ["node", "--import", "/app/server/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs", "/app/server/deploy.mjs"]
